comments: Two groups of rules are switched off here.
Formatting: this CSS was hand-written in a compact one-rule-per-line idiom,
with tokens grouped by blank lines and a couple of selectors deliberately
reopened in a later section. Reformatting all of it would churn ~1,100 lines
is a portfolio recruiters may open on an old work machine. max-width works
everywhere, so the mobile layout should not depend on a newer browser.
stylelint-config-html/astro teaches Stylelint to parse <style> blocks inside
.astro files via postcss-html. No .astro file has one today (styles are global
CSS in src/styles/ by design) — this is future-proofing, per RW-151.
